title: Nephalem Rift
description: Enter the rift, fill its progress and slay the Rift Guardian, then report to the Rift Keeper.
notes: Q5 text approved by ruling 2026-09-16 (decisions.md, 09-rifts 7.9.7). Monster spawning S3 (docs/proposals/monster-spawning.md 3.9.4): one quest per mode, counting hundredths of a D3 progress point; 30,000 = 300 points = 100% of the bar, inside the core's 16-bit quest counter (at most 65,535). Ruling 2026-10-16 (decisions.md, diablocraft-owe7u): 30,000, down from the 65,000 (D3's 650 points, warpath's FAQ) that rifts_0019_one_bar.sql set; rifts_0032_bar_target.sql sets the new count. Warpath's per-monster points (data/d3/gr_monster_progress.csv) are still points of D3's 650-point bar and are not scaled. It replaces the kills_required variants 910021 and 910022, retired by rifts_0019_one_bar.sql.
